reviews.text: I absolutely loved it! I’m so happy and grateful for how patient, gentle, and sweet everyone was with my Luna. She can be a little shy and nervous, so it meant so much to me that she was treated with so much love and care. Thank you for making her feel comfortable and safe! 🥰🐾💕
We love bringing our dogs to city paws!

We live in humble but we’ve been going here since Baxter was a baby and he’s never known another groomer. In addition to always doing a fantastic job, they also are so loving towards my baby and it makes the drive well worth it.
My little terror always comes home looking fabulous.  Would definitely recommend this place for your grooming needs
Thank you so much for your review! We really appreciate it!

Great service, especially for poodle adjacent breeds. They took extra time with my dog to get him accustomed to their tools and deal with his anxieties. The grow out from their cuts is also very impressive. He looks well groomed even after a few months. The photo is from today’s cut.
Loved the service and how kind and helpful was the staff. I will always trust them

“I had the best experience with Sofia! My little Snoopy usually gets nervous, but they were so patient and gentle with him. When I picked him up, he looked incredible — clean, perfectly trimmed, and smelling amazing. You can tell they really care about the animals and take pride in their work. The shop was clean, organized, and very welcoming. I’ll definitely be BACK!!!
THANK YOU! Thank you!!!! 🫶🏽

Super friendly staff , I don’t trust everybody with my doodle grooming and my first time going they did amazing! They gave my boy a great Mini Groom and also recommended me to the best products to use to keep him put together! Thank y’all so much !!! This will be our forever grooming home in Houston Tx !

Had very mixed experiences here. As far as grooming goes, they always do a really good job and I think the price is reasonable.

That said, the owner/manager is rude and difficult to communicate with. My dog had a bit of matting under his belly that needs to be shaved and I was charged a mild dematting fee. That is fine and I paid that bill and had zero intention of refusing to pay. If they want to have a hard line about any matting, that’s their prerogative. I asked the manager where the matting was and I said that my dogs hair was very fine, long, and dense and prone to matting and that it would be hard to bring him in zero matts. I am very careful to brush and comb him every day as new tangles form within a day. In response, she told me that I could find a different groomer. I was totally calm and was intending to come back, but clearly she would prefer that I find another groomer. She told me that if their two afghan hound clients can come in without a single mat, then so should I. Her only advice was “do you have a comb?” Using a comb every day will not prevent tangles from forming from a harness during the drive to the groomer.

I’m not going to argue about the condition of his coat because it’s her word against mine. I only wanted to discuss the light matting and she was condescending and defensive and told me to find another groomer. Completely unnecessary. You can see the aggression and unprofessionalism in her responses to other negative reviews.
This place is amazing. The girls there are sooo nice. Highly recomend!!

I’ve been bringing my fur baby here for years!  The owners and their staff are fantastic!   They treat my pup Lady with so much love, and she always looks amazing after her visits.  They also have great products to keep her smelling good in between her grooming appointments.

I’d recommend them to anyone.   They’re the absolute best 🫶🏼.

CityPaws has been my go-to for yearssss on maintaining my beautiful dog’s coat. I have recommended numerous friends and family since, and everybody has been loyal to them ever since. Their team is always professional, caring, and truly loves animals. My dogs always leave looking and feeling amazing! I wouldn’t trust anyone else!
Rudest front desk person I have ever had to interact with.
Thank you so much! 😊 We appreciate you trusting us with your little guy!  …

Ms. Danni was so warm and inviting. She made me and my two little babies feel so welcomed. I’m not exactly sure who groomed my youngest, Beignet, but that person did a phenomenal job. They were able to shape Beignet’s face perfectly. They have truly earned the title “poodle/doodle” headquarters. Thank you City Paws!!

I can’t thank this team enough for the way they take care of my dog, Rio. He’s been coming here since he was just a puppy, and every single visit has been nothing but positive. The staff is always warm, professional, and attentive, and you can tell they truly care about the pets they look after. Rio gets so excited every time we pull up, which tells me everything I need to know about how well he’s treated here.

The facility is always clean, welcoming, and safe, and the customer service goes above and beyond. As a pet parent, it gives me so much peace of mind knowing Rio is in such good hands. Thank you for treating him like family—we’ll continue to be loyal customers for years to come!
